variants.A:
Use case: ads-marketing. One single wide landscape 16:9 key art image for the indie browser game RONGBOY, designed to read in a tiny CrazyGames thumbnail. Input 1 is the exact hero, Rongboy. Keep his tan explorer hat, circular brass goggles on hatband, felt brown hair, yellow scarf, simple black button-like eyes, olive shorts, tan scout jacket. Input 2 is character design reference only: select the leftmost olive-green plush zombie with asymmetric tan and brown X-button eyes, forehead patch, stuck-on cream teeth, stitched rust waistcoat and patched trousers; no diagram labels. Input 3 is environment reference only: teal stitched rebound board, hedge maze, toy-scale garden, cream cylindrical spool pistol with the copper/rust rim. Do not copy any HUD or Chinese labels from the references. Physical handmade needle-felt miniature photography, highly tactile visible short wool fibers, embroidered seams, sewn patches, diffuse carefully layered natural light, grounded toy dimensions. Cute and mischievous plush zombies, zero gore, zero photoreal firearms. Show just one actual chunky yarn ball and readable coherent rebound direction. Typography: only exact title "RONGBOY", seven letters, in a custom bold retro toy-packaging serif that reads small, no subtitle, branding marks, CTA, UI, watermark, borders or black bars. Full bleed.
Hero-led garden action. Medium close hero from three quarters front on the left, about waist high in frame, holding the cream spool pistol with both hands, with expressive little smile and hat fully visible. One readable olive zombie on right at middle depth with arms out, tilting in surprise. A yellow cream woolball clearly banks off a diagonal teal cloth wall in between, with one simple golden thread’s reflected V trail, very understated. Warm early-afternoon sun, green hedge, russet accents on embroidery, creamy gold graphic title in open upper left/center unobstructed above the hero. Camera at doll eye level, punchy collectible toy packaging, total emphasis on hero face and warm adventure, strong silhouettes in center safe area.

revisionC: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the cover artwork to edit. Make exactly one character correction: remove the tan explorer character who is peeking over the hedge at far right. Replace that former figure's silhouette with the established sunlit garden hedge and soft warm sky. Preserve the exact title RONGBOY, typography, title position, focus and face of the olive felt zombie, woolball and the lower right first-person spool pistol and its existing hand, stitched teal wall, sunset light and image framing. Camera is the hero's point of view. The shooter is represented once, by the gun and hand. Result is one single 16:9 edge-to-edge cover with no added words or character.

submissionRecompositions.portrait:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the approved marketing artwork to recompose for a different CrazyGames cover aspect ratio. Keep exactly the selected B artwork's identities and tactile overall look: startled yellow-olive needle-felt zombie with the large mismatched tan and brown X-button eyes, crooked dark mouth with spaced square felt teeth, stitched olive forehead patch and rust waistcoat, heroic little Rongboy with rounded tan explorer hat and brass goggles on the hatband, brown hair felt shapes, button eyes and yellow scarf, cream spool pistol with rust rim, and one ivory wool ball already rebounding beside the zombie's cheek against the teal stitched felt wall. Keep the dusk blue-green sky, golden rim lighting, low toy garden hedge and hyper-real tactile short felt fibers. The zombie face and single yarn ball are the immediate hook. Keep the distinctive cream appliqué stitched bold serif title style of the source, and recenter it at the top with comfortable breathing room. Exact title and only text "RONGBOY" spelled R O N G B O Y. One scene, cohesive and edge-to-edge. No white or black borders, no graphics badge, no other character, no extra balls, no text apart from title. Reposition characters to recompose the original artwork rather than letterbox or hard-crop the landscape.
Render the entire frame in strict portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. Compose for a small 800×1200 store cover. Title across the top in one centered horizontal line with at least 5% clearance from the left and right. Big startled zombie's face in the center of the upper-middle, its eyes and teeth fully in frame, clay-like doll arms visible below. One clearly visible large ivory yarn ball up and right beside the zombie's face, against a diagonally stitched teal wall on the right. Place Rongboy half-length in the lower-left foreground as a separate smaller and complete silhouette, face and hat readable, arm holding spool pistol aimed rightward into the scene. Layer rather than squeeze: title first, huge zombie and ball next, smaller scout below-left. Strong subject separation and no abrupt crop of the hat or yarn ball. Keep full bleed.
